name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for drywall texture repair?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for drywall texture repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for drywall texture repair, look for experience specifically with texture matching and repair. Ask to see examples of previous work, especially on textures similar to yours. Ensure they are licensed and insured, which protects you from liability. Check reviews and testimonials for reliability and quality of craftsmanship. A good contractor will also provide a detailed, written estimate and clearly communicate the repair process and timeline. Local contractors familiar with Bay Area homes, like City Dweller, LLC, often have a better understanding of common regional issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for experience in texture matching, ask for references, ensure they are licensed and insured, and get a detailed written estimate. Local contractors often have relevant regional experience.
